algorithm.hypotheses: The unchanged geometry_certificate? predicate supplies an actual PPG path, N>=3, every observed step above the cutoff and actual measured curvature<=bound. The coordinate map and walk are the same inputs as the computed coherence.
algorithm.budget: curvature_scale=(N-2)*actual curvature_lmax on N>=3, with the maximum over FIRST N-2 denominator lengths (last observed step excluded). curvature_budget=curvature_scale*nonnegative bound; raw scale is zero on shorter walks, which cannot carry a geometry certificate.
algorithm.angle_result: certified_angle_budget derives acos(actual endpoint_coherence)<=curvature_budget from the previously proved universal lower bound. No alignment premise is assumed.
algorithm.small_budget_result: When curvature_budget<=pi, certified_coherence_small_budget proves actual endpoint_coherence>=cos(curvature_budget). The conditional window is equivalently bound<=pi/positive curvature_scale.
algorithm.global_result: certified_coherence_global proves actual endpoint_coherence>=cos(min(pi,curvature_budget)). Budgets>=pi yield only the trivial floor -1, never cosine of an unrestricted angle budget.
algorithm.combined_result: A strict floor below the derived cosine floor is sufficient for unchanged combined_certificate?. A guarded iff with geometry_certificate? is proved only under that strict margin, not universally.
algorithm.direct_threshold: For target_floor in[-1,1], geometry_certificate? and bound<acos(target_floor)/curvature_scale imply combined_certificate? at that floor. The threshold is sufficient, not necessary for actual coherence or acceptance.
algorithm.boundary_examples: The original normalized unequal-step low_walk has actual bound pi/sqrt2, budget pi/2 and coherence0: combined_certificate? holds exactly for floors<0, so equality at the derived floor fails. The original straight prefix has bound0, budget0 and coherence1, but combined floor1 also fails.
algorithm.unchanged_interface: Existing lie_pp_connection source/proofs and report-binding predicates remain byte-unchanged; no implementation alignment check is removed.
algorithm.boundary: Exact real mathematics; endpoint-direction coherence is not C20 coupling alignment. No physical calibration, binary64/Python/C refinement, natural RR or new Lean counterpart is asserted. The three captured budget diagnostics are separate from formal certificate instantiation.
